summary: Case case-002 (prof.kaya@aegean.edu) assessed benign, confidence 0.85. F4 indicates 10 sign-ins from Portugal via VPN vpn-edge-02 on device LT-3104. Three alerts were rejected by Critic: impossible travel Manisa→Lisbon (32 min) was a non-interactive ExchangeSync/15 mail-sync token, not the user; 193.140.10.21 failures against 54 accounts are shared Turkcell NAT noise, not password spray; VPN KEV CVEs are fixed on firmware 22.7R2.8. No compromise signal remained.

findings.claim: Most sign-ins come from PT (10 events)

rejected_claims.claim: Impossible travel: Manisa → Lisbon in 32 min
rejected_claims.reason: critic: premature impossible-travel claim: the TR event is a non-interactive mail-sync token (ExchangeSync/15), not the person; the PT sign-ins use university VPN vpn-edge-02 from device LT-3104

rejected_claims.claim: Password spray then success: 193.140.10.21 failed against 54 accounts (60 failures) and later signed in as this user
rejected_claims.reason: critic: 193.140.10.21 belongs to shared-NAT ASN "Turkcell" (60/60 failures from shared-NAT ASNs); failures across many accounts are expected background noise, not a coordinated spray

rejected_claims.claim: VPN appliance vpn-edge-02 (firmware 22.7R2.8) runs a product listed in CISA KEV (CVE-2026-104935, CVE-2025-22457, CVE-2025-0282, …)
rejected_claims.reason: critic: firmware 22.7R2.8 already includes the fixes for the KEV entries we can version-check (CVE-2025-22457, CVE-2025-0282)

actions.action: Confirm LT-3104 is assigned to prof.kaya and review sign-in timestamps against expected user activity.
Correlate 193.140.10.21 NAT logs with other accounts to validate shared-NAT background-noise baseline.
Verify vpn-edge-02 firmware patch level and run a vulnerability scan for CVE-2026-104935, CVE-2025-22457, CVE-2025-0282.

limitations:

- No identity provider MFA logs examined.
not_checked:

critic_verdicts.reason: premature impossible-travel claim: the TR event is a non-interactive mail-sync token (ExchangeSync/15), not the person; the PT sign-ins use university VPN vpn-edge-02 from device LT-3104
193.140.10.21 belongs to shared-NAT ASN "Turkcell" (60/60 failures from shared-NAT ASNs); failures across many accounts are expected background noise, not a coordinated spray
firmware 22.7R2.8 already includes the fixes for the KEV entries we can version-check (CVE-2025-22457, CVE-2025-0282)
no independent check for this signal; kept as LIKELY

risk.rationale: All indicative compromise signals for prof.kaya@aegean.edu have been rejected with verified explanations: (1) the Manisa→Lisbon 'impossible travel' is a non-interactive ExchangeSync/15 mail token, not a human sign-in, while the Portugal events authenticate through university VPN vpn-edge-02 from known device LT-3104; (2) the 193.140.10.21 failures are shared-NAT Turkcell background noise across 54 accounts, not a coordinated spray against this user; (3) the VPN appliance's CISA KEV CVEs are fixed on the running firmware 22.7R2.8. The only remaining verified signal, F4 (most sign-ins from Portugal, LIKELY 0.5), is consistent with legitimate remote VPN use from a known university device. No data-quality conflicts exist and no account-takeover chain is confirmed.
